description: Search the SmartVisuals catalog by keyword. Returns matching Power BI custom visuals with their slug, name, publication status and a reason explaining why each result matched. Use this to discover which visual fits a reporting need (e.g. 'retention cohort', 'radar comparison', 'time series forecast').

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10, max 50)

query.description: Space-separated keywords to match against visual names, descriptions, use cases and tags

name: find_visuals
title: Find Visuals
